item.content:encoded:
This is an invented sample post about feeding a sourdough starter. It exists only so the feed parser has realistic markup to read.

Read the short guide for the main steps, or skim the list below.

What to Check First

Start with the simple things. Most problems come from skipping a basic step.

  • Use equal weights of flour and water
  • Feed at the same time each day
  • Keep the jar somewhere warm, not hot

Common Questions

How long does it take? Usually less than an hour.

Do you need special tools? No. A cloth, a brush and some patience are enough.

Summary

Small, regular care goes a long way. That is the whole idea behind feeding a sourdough starter.

What to Check First

Start with the simple things. Most problems come from skipping a basic step.

  • Use less yeast than for a same-day loaf
  • Cover the bowl so the dough does not dry
  • Let it warm up before shaping

Common Questions

How long does it take? Usually less than an hour.

Do you need special tools? No. A cloth, a brush and some patience are enough.

Summary

Small, regular care goes a long way. That is the whole idea behind proofing dough overnight.
